The '''Technical division''', also called the '''tech service department''',<ref name="Way of the Apprentice">''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]''</ref> of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was an organization of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] that operated prior to, and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[J'oopi Shé/Legends|J'oopi Shé]] was a prominent member of the division, and was known to assist the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]] during the final days of the Republic.

Operating out of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the division was responsible for maintaining and repairing all craft in the Temple. The Jedi involved were in charge of directing the [[Temple employee|Temple technicians]]; the non-Jedi employees at the Temple.

After the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the division was dissolved and all its members were executed, or went into hiding, as is the case with [[Kazdan Paratus]], who secluded himself on the ruined planet of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] rebuilt the [[New Jedi Order|Order]], the division was reformed within the [[new Jedi Temple]].
